generate_unicode_data_cpp: generate a C++ unicode-data.cpp file with codepoint flags, whitespace sets, and NFD mappings from Unicode UCD data
build_unicode_category_flags: build a codepoint flag lookup table mapping Unicode categories to bitmask flags for regex character classes
build_unicode_case_tables: build lowercase and uppercase conversion tables from Unicode Data for codepoint pairs
build_unicode_nfd_ranges: build normalized form decomposition (NFD) range tables for codepoint normalization lookups
run_unicode_data_generation: run the script to download Unicode data and output generated C++ source code to stdout
